The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 df6227b615985805), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 52. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.

There is a constant Cη, independent of ℓ and the layer, such that ∥We∥ ≤ Cη. Augmenting an original tower label by its matrix weight gives a finite positive alphabet of size o(dD). The normalizing number Dik is determined by the original part of the label. 2. The voltage cover has no nonempty cyclically nonbacktracking closed walk based in layer i of length at most C∗Hi/ log2 d. 3.
